attributes.action: Make Planespotting Easier Around the UK
attributes.additional_details: Make open planespotting spots for aviation enthusiasts around the UK at many commercial airports.
attributes.background: At Airports like Newcastle International, there’s no easy way to planespot wether it’s younger or older people there’s no easy way to, the planespotting community would appreciate it massively if there was a way to spot without going to random fields or standing in illegal places.
